summary: PMS Link — Owner rates flow into rate_overrides and booking engine fully tested. All 12 tests passed covering: submit-to-pms creates rate_overrides doc with set_by='owner-override' and locked=true, effective rate priority (pms_override > target_sell_rate > live_pms_rate), guardrails (max of min_rate, floor_rate), booking engine per-night rate lookup from rate_overrides, fallback to base_price when no override, mixed booking (override + base), idempotency (update not duplicate), grid reads owner-override as live_pms_rate, availability array per row, and public booking endpoint.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/rates/grid/submit-to-pms correctly writes to BOTH owner_rate_overrides AND rate_overrides collections
rate_overrides doc created with set_by='owner-override', locked=true, custom_rate=effective_rate
Effective rate priority correctly implemented: pms_override > target_sell_rate > live_pms_rate
Guardrail correctly applied: effective = max(effective, min_rate, floor_rate)
POST /api/booking/reserve correctly does per-night rate lookup against rate_overrides where set_by='owner-override'
Booking with override date uses custom_rate (e.g., 150), not base_price (89)
Booking without override correctly falls back to room_types.base_price
Mixed booking (1 night override + 1 night no override) correctly sums: override + base_price
Idempotency verified: re-submitting same date UPDATEs rate_overrides doc (not duplicates)
GET /api/rates/grid reads back live_pms_rate from rate_overrides 'owner-override' lock
Grid rows include availability:[] array with room_type_id, name, total, booked, free per day
Availability free count = total - booked (verified correct)
/api/booking/reserve is PUBLIC (no auth required) - confirmed working
seed_data_creation: Test bookings created with dates 2027-02-15 to 2027-04-02 for PMS link verification. Test overrides created for dates 2027-02-15, 2027-02-17, 2027-02-18, 2027-02-19.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PMS link fully verified. Owner rates set in 'My Rates' panel flow correctly into rate_overrides collection (with set_by='owner-override', locked=true) and are picked up by the booking engine for per-night pricing. Property 'aldgate-flats' has room type 'double-aldgate-flats' with base_price=89. Availability array in grid rows shows per-room-type counts.
